text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, I pondered heading out
to take a breather since I had the time.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —You there.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Well timed. Follow Us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her unyielding presence, before I knew it,
I had been led straight into—a sporting goods store boasting various top brands.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Hm... For now, I shall test the new line of sportswear.
You, hold two of those.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Directed by her sharp gaze, I instinctively reached for the items as told...
until a sudden doubt crossed my mind.
Why am I the one helping her with her shopping...?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
What is it?
You are the porter; obey with haste.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
There should be gloves as well—ah, these.
Functionality, texture... satisfactory.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Hey, take two of these as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The gym training gloves she pointed to seem to be a new release from an up-and-coming brand.
These look great for <chrname> too—
choice_data_list: Wait, no! Um, why am I—
Wait, no! Um, why am I—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: To the register. We move on to the next.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next place she brought me to was
a bookstore packed with specialized racing literature.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Those research texts over there.
Every volume in that training theory series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Crushed by her irresistible authority, I picked up
one race-related book after another as commanded.
choice_data_list: (Ah, this one looks interesting... Wait, focus!)

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Next.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: —We shall drop by that shop as well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Carrying an ever-growing pile of bags, I chased after her while gasping for breath.
Reaching my physical limit, I finally called out to stop her—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Are you not a Trainer?
What use are you without the stamina to handle a mere task like this?
choice_data_list: Well, you might have a point, but still...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To fully support <chrname> as a Trainer, basic physical fitness is indeed vital.
Even so, that feels entirely separate from being dragged around like this—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Endure it. —Forward.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One way or another, I was dragged all over the place.
With an outrageous pile of luggage, I was exhausted to the point where my arms were trembling, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
A break is permitted. We still have the journey back;
recover that frail stamina of yours, even if just a little.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While gratefully ordering coffee...
I couldn't help but wonder why she chose me to carry her luggage in the first place.
choice_data_list: Why did you ask me to help out?
Why did you ask me to help out?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: A Trainer responsible for horse girls must constantly broaden their horizons.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: The same applies to basic physical fitness.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing that, I looked back on the day's events.
By accompanying her shopping trip, I had gained valuable insights into new products and intriguing books.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I also realized just how out of shape I had become—
Indeed, one could argue that this was a good learning experience... perhaps.
choice_data_list: Then... could you tell me about the contents of that book?
Thank you, I learned a lot today.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a specialized training theory book, but a title I hadn't read before.
Since the chance presented itself, I wanted to learn more.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
You dare... seek teachings from We, the King?
What insolent greed.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
One must possess an insatiable hunger for knowledge, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Consider this your reward.
Once I have finished reading it, I shall bestow it upon you. Work hard on the way back as well.

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
Gratitude should be demonstrated in action.
Offer up some entertainment for Our amusement.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Panicking at the sudden unreasonable demand, my mind raced.
Entertainment... meaning a quick party trick...?! 
In any case, something everyone knows—
choice_data_list: I-I'll dance the Umapyoi! U~ Umadacchi!

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text: Boring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Though my performance fell flat on its face, she let me rest leisurely until it was time to head back.
